title: The Go For It Giveaway and the Reorder
lessons: The player encounters ZYN's 2026 Go For It Giveaway, which asked eligible adult nicotine consumers to submit a short video describing a dream adventure.
The player tries to reorder ZYN from ZYN.com and discovers the brand no longer sells product directly through its own online store.

text: Between sets, someone in the group mentions ZYN was giving away dream trips. You did not know that was a thing. Counsel did.

entry-first-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: Wait. ZYN was offering people dream trips?

entry-first-2.speaker: COUNSEL
text: During the 2026 contest window, yes. Eligible adults could submit one video, under a minute, vertical, describing the adventure they wanted and why. That is the pitch. I am about to ruin it.

entry-first-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: And the prize?

entry-first-4.speaker: COUNSEL
text: Ten winners. Up to fifteen thousand dollars each. The sponsor decides how your adventure gets interpreted and fulfilled, within the rules.

entry-first-5.speaker: PLAYER
text: You made "dream trip" sound like procurement.

entry-first-6.speaker: COUNSEL
text: No purchase necessary. Not open in Massachusetts, Michigan, or Virginia. Adult nicotine users only.

entry-first-7.speaker: PLAYER
text: Of course there was more.

entry-first-8.speaker: COUNSEL
text: There is always more.

choice-first.speaker: COUNSEL
text: The next act is walking on. You have roughly ninety seconds to react before I lose you to bass.

choices.text: Honestly, a brand paying for someone's ridiculous dream trip is fun.
I'd read the fine print before uploading my face and my story.
I don't want my idea of adventure attached to a nicotine promotion.

first-1.speaker: COUNSEL
text: Yes. That was the idea. The rules were written by people who knew it was fun. I was one of them. I found it less fun.

first-2.speaker: COUNSEL
text: Appropriate. The rules give the sponsor broad rights to use, edit, publish, and promote whatever you submit. Your face included.

first-2-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: There is the lawyer I was expecting.

first-2-2.speaker: COUNSEL
text: I have been present continuously.

first-3.speaker: COUNSEL
text: No purchase, no entry, no obligation. Your adventure may remain unsponsored. Most do.
Later, you try to reorder from ZYN.com. You are logged in. There is nothing to buy.

entry-return-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: I'm already logged in. Why can't I just buy it here?

entry-return-2.speaker: COUNSEL
text: The ZYN Store is suspended. The site now sends adults to independent retailers, Nicokick and Northerner, or to a store near them. It does not sell.

entry-return-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: So the official website tells me to leave the official website.

entry-return-4.speaker: COUNSEL
text: For purposes of buying anything, yes.

choice-return.speaker: COUNSEL
text: You are frowning at a sign-in page you no longer need. Say something.

choices.text: Fine. Just tell me where it's available.
That's a strange amount of friction for a brand this big.
If I have to chase it through another retailer, I'll skip it.

return-1.speaker: COUNSEL
text: The current site is functioning as a routing layer rather than the seller of record.

return-1-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: You found a way to make "store locator" sound litigious.

return-1-2.speaker: COUNSEL
text: Seller-of-record status is not decorative.

return-2.speaker: COUNSEL
text: It is. Owning the brand does not mean owning the checkout. I cannot explain why in a sentence you would enjoy.

return-3.speaker: COUNSEL
text: Then the purchase does not occur. Nothing obligates you to keep looking. I mean that as a comfort, in my way.
